notes: Single competency C-a3b20c21 (transcribe an algorithm from a photograph of code): a rotated/noisy whiteboard photo of a parameterized checksum routine; OCR garbles at least one line per photo, so the constants must be read visually and the routine evaluated. Hidden cases are fresh photographs with different L/U/F/S/K constants and call argument n; any misread digit or operator yields a different integer and fails exact equality. Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (order-of-operations reconstruction), debugging_ambiguity (OCR noise must be worked around), adversarial_inputs (degraded photo), hidden_case_generalization (solve.py re-run on unseen photos), and quantitative_correctness (exact integer).
